contexts.statement: OpenAI Math Audit #014: Restricted geometric Langlands, global Arthur enhancements, and generic Ramanujan.

Simultaneous compact arithmetic boundary gluing for PGL_n over a finite extension L/Q_l, on a characteristic-zero lift of a finite-field curve with a finite reduced marked divisor; Frobenius may permute geometric punctures, nilpotent boundary logarithms are arbitrary including zero, and coefficients are not acted on by Frobenius.

definitions.q: The finite-field cardinality, an integer greater than one prime to l; a puncture orbit of length d has return multiplier q^d.
definitions.arithmetic_action: A specified semilinear isomorphism of the entire finite right-torsor tower, not an arithmetic structure deduced from a geometric eigensheaf.
definitions.scope: Only parameters and their tensor local systems are constructed; no Weil eigensheaf theorem or novelty verdict is assumed.

claims.natural_statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 014 (Restricted geometric Langlands, global Arthur enhancements, and generic Ramanujan.; papers: Global Arthur Enhancements of Cuspidal Excursion Parameters; Rationality of the Canonical Unramified Arthur Filtration; Ramanujan-Arthur Decompositions of Cuspidal Functions at Full Finite Level; Temperedness at ramified places for globally generic exceptional groups; The Restricted Geometric Langlands Equivalence in Positive Characteristic; Constructible tame Hecke eigensheaves in positive characteristic; Tame Hecke Eigensheaves with Several Marked Points; Frobenius Structures on Tame Hecke Eigensheaves; Lean status: UNFORMALIZED (No Lean proof in openai/math)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

A compact-valued arithmetic PGL_n parameter with dense geometric image and tame unipotent boundary at finitely many punctures admits one ramified auxiliary Kummer cover and a simultaneous balanced nodal smoothing carrying a compact-valued dense unramified parameter, with the original component parameters and their prescribed arithmetic action recovered by a compatible torsor tower; all nilpotent Jordan types, zero, nonsemisimple Frobenius matrices and Frobenius-permuted punctures are allowed.

If A in PGL_n(L), N in pgl_n(L), and Ad(A)N=rN with r in L of infinite multiplicative order, the q-chain heights of generalized eigenspaces of any matrix lift define a cocharacter over L, independent of the lift, centralizing A and scaling N with weight one; its lift has integer weights between zero and n-1. Semisimplicity of A and regularity of N are unnecessary.

For finitely many boundary cocharacters and a compact subgroup H0 of PGL_n(L), one compact open subgroup J contains H0 and all P_i=c_i(-1/e) for one integer e>1 prime to l. With Frobenius-permuted fibers the cocharacters and P_i can be chosen to intertwine every prescribed arithmetic transport.

On a smooth projective characteristic-zero curve with a finite nonempty reduced marked divisor and compatible tangent parameters, weak approximation gives one rational function having simple zero with prescribed first jet at every marking. Normalizing w^e=t gives a geometrically connected degree-e auxiliary cover, one point over each marking with unchanged residue field, and exactly e times the boundary character with identical arithmetic transport.

A continuous arithmetic PGL_n parameter on a finite-field smooth punctured curve, killing wild inertia and with unipotent tame boundary, lifts via proper root stacks to a compact-valued characteristic-zero parameter with the same geometric image and its entire prescribed arithmetic torsor tower, including all boundary transports.

Independently chosen node identifications P_i satisfying P_i exp(-e a N_i) P_i^-1=exp(a N_i) and all arithmetic transport squares glue finite right-torsor towers on balanced twisted models; proper henselian invariance lifts them to the smoothing and preserves every tower and arithmetic relation, with no additional dual-graph cycle relation.

In compatible frames the geometric generic monodromy of the lifted proper twisted-curve torsor tower contains the first punctured component monodromy at every finite quotient and hence in the common compact group J; therefore it is Zariski dense.

routes.retired_because: Reusing diagonalizability from the manuscript regular case fails for nonregular N: A=diag(U,qU), U a nontrivial 2-by-2 unipotent block, and N the lower off-diagonal identity satisfy AN=qNA but A is not semisimple. This is a failure of the proposed extension route, not a false literal manuscript assertion. Generalized primary spaces replace eigenvectors.
